screenshots.caption: A synthetic field-service PDF produced three canonical topics with zero errors. This actual installed build card retains its revision and evidence downloads. The negative-test markup in its title is displayed literally.

The actual comparator reports one added, two removed and one changed topic. Removing an overview that contains a safety notice requires human review. Expand the evidence or download its JSON to inspect all details; these counts do not approve a release.

observedTests.name: Installed original workflows
observedTests.observed: Real PDFs, citations, publication blocks, revised safety content, exact downloads, literal search, editing races, mobile layout and accessibility passed. Four builds/two projects survived three normal exits, including work accepted before Quit.

observedTests.name: Source and hosted gates
observedTests.observed: 290 source cases plus 13 isolated Tk/notice cases; 91.24% combined statement/branch coverage with the original 90% floor. Five editor model cases, strict types, audits, three OS native consumers and all three raw CodeQL categories passed.

observedTests.name: Distribution and menu
observedTests.observed: Both downloaded assets matched provider identities and checksums. All 114 installed files stayed unchanged. Native Open/Help/Exit and owned HTTP readiness passed, followed by another normal exit and closed listener; individual icon targets were verified.

visualReview.scope: Every unchanged final page individually viewed; document, screenshots and immutable source identities checked.

sourceEvidence.scope: Dated exact-runtime observations; private controller paths, raw receipts and user profiles are not published.
